display_name: LoRa 原生 8,192 点 冻结 E104 强扰动恢复（Full）
description: Restore all 8192 contiguous complex points before the original W24 frontend.
authorization: User requested native 8192 Full DURA and native 8192 best E104 loss + pseudo-label runs.

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI archived W24 and immutable release; local CPU independent truth-last collector.
code.cwd: Released archived W24 implementation directory; LoRa experiment files resolved from immutable new release.

data.representation: Continuous 8192 complex samples at 1 MS/s in and out of G. The original 8 x 2 x 432 W24 preprocessing runs on restored full raw IQ.
data.physical_ids_ref: Ordered source V physical IDs and archived blind RX order, 2000 target packets per receiver
data.label_map_ref: Original W24 frozen class mapping; target labels scorer only
data.leo_config_ref: Registered native Full clean and six practical views.

permissions.claim_scope: L_s true TX CE; high-confidence >=0.95 E104 clean U_s pseudo CE; same-packet generic IQ pairs. E104 frozen. No V/target/hidden U_s TX or practical traces in training.

checkpoint.initialization: Verified same-source strong W24 PacketUNet inherited. Preserve common tensors and interpolate only 48 to 128 time-position tokens; reset optimizer. Original classifier frozen.

sources.role: Same-contract G initialization and archived Full comparison.
Frozen source training teacher and evaluation default head.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact W24 E104 contract, source U-Net proof, L_s ID and ten class mapping, U_s metadata without y.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Native raw data and source physical roles match LoRa archived contract. Formal historical results stay out of training and thresholds.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Source-fixed 18000-step final checkpoint only. Require more six-scene correct than listed matched controls, at least their best low urban and at least direct/strong parent clean on preregistered 300 Full V packets; conditional 30000-packet Full.

execution.gpu_policy: N607 priority [2,3]. At least 12 GiB free and fewer than eight compute contexts. One train worker; up to two formal workers across distinct GPUs.
execution.stop_rule: Stop dependent on invalid contract/source parent, failed native checkpoint smoke, nonfinite update, wrong raw support, unauthorized data role or incomplete predictions. Source miss leaves formal unopened.

metric_names: sampled waveform and clean training losses
strong source branch actual sampled exposures and nominal SNR range
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Independent source score then conditional local w24_joint_pamf collect after all Full shards are frozen.

rows.method: All native PacketUNet recovery weights, fixed E104 CE + clean pseudo labels
rows.seed_notes: 2026113011 physical draws and capture simulation; fixed source-only selection without target.
rows.optimizer: AdamW lr 4e-05, cosine, weight decay 1e-4, gradient clip 1.
rows.budget_ref: 18000 updates of this stage; 144000 source packet exposures in each L_s and U_s role.

notes: Native PacketUNet with 8 x 1024 sample support, raw-band tracking from public chirp, no W24 crop or sampling before G. Restore all native samples; apply W24 original aperture after G. Same source roles, E104 teacher and nominal strong-noise recipe. Geometric weights of original W24 parent retained except time embeddings resized.
The restored waveform still goes to a single original frozen classification head. Target stays blind before all predictions are fixed.
